query:
WITH youth_population AS (
    SELECT 
        hl.municipality,
        COUNT(DISTINCT hp.id) AS youth_count
    FROM estishraf_llm_historical_population_impala hp
    JOIN estishraf_llm_home_location hl ON hp.id = hl.id
    WHERE hp.is_in_population = TRUE
      AND hp.snapshot = (SELECT MAX(snapshot) FROM estishraf_llm_historical_population_impala)
      AND hp.age BETWEEN 18 AND 30
      AND hl.region = 'منطقة الرياض'
      AND hl.municipality IS NOT NULL
    GROUP BY hl.municipality
),
municipality_areas AS (
    SELECT 
        municipality,
        COUNT(DISTINCT district) AS district_count
    FROM estishraf_llm_home_location
    WHERE region = 'منطقة الرياض'
      AND municipality IS NOT NULL
    GROUP BY municipality
)
SELECT 
    yp.municipality,
    yp.youth_count,
    ma.district_count,
    yp.youth_count / ma.district_count AS density
FROM youth_population yp
JOIN municipality_areas ma ON yp.municipality = ma.municipality
ORDER BY density DESC
LIMIT 1
